name: Jupiter
description: Your private music universe: own, organize, stream, download and understand your music.

aiTools.name: jupiter.search
aiTools.description: Search the user's private Jupiter music library by song, artist, album or tag.

aiTools.name: jupiter.play
aiTools.description: Queue and play songs from the user's Jupiter library. Use search first when the request names music.

aiTools.name: jupiter.stats
aiTools.description: Get the user's Jupiter listening statistics and most played music.

aiTools.name: jupiter.createPlaylist
aiTools.description: Create a Jupiter playlist from songs in the user's private library.

aiGuidance: JUPITER is the user's private music library. Only music stored in Jupiter is playable. Never invent a track, artist, album or URL. For requests such as 'play my favourite Afrobeats', search the library first, then use jupiter.play. Playback commands are requests the Jupiter app consumes on the user's device; do not claim audio started unless the tool reports it. Use jupiter.stats for listening history and analytics.
